title: Onboard Generate — v3 Context Shape
description: The single documented source for the internal-generation context object that onboard:start builds and onboard:generate (Step 0) validates. v3 is the ONLY accepted shape (the v2 external-caller API was removed in 3.0.0). The context is the internal v1-shaped object (version:3 + analysis + wizardAnswers + enriched + modelChoice + ecosystemPlugins + callerExtras + an OPTIONAL top-level `research` object, canonical shape: onboard/schemas/research-dossier.json) that generate and config-generator consume directly. There is no `phases` block and no inheritance from a v2 schema. v1 and v2 are rejected. This schema is DESCRIPTIVE and deliberately permissive: `required[]` is only [version, source, projectPath, callerExtras] and `additionalProperties` is true at every level, because generate Step 0 validates the REAL runtime context against it — the added property definitions below document the full shape while leaving `required[]` and `additionalProperties` untouched, so every well-formed context is accepted exactly as before. (Naming a property is not free of effect: a named key with a declared type is checked against that type, whereas `additionalProperties:true` only waves through keys this schema does NOT name. So a malformed value under a now-named key — e.g. `analysis` as a string — rejects where it previously slipped past. No well-formed context is affected, and that is pinned by evidence rather than asserted: schemas/examples/ carries a positive fixture per generate caller — start, update's `regenerateOnly` re-emit, and evolve's `reResearch` regen — so a re-narrowing of any named key fails check-schemas.py.) Deep per-event shapes for callerExtras.qualityGates are specified in generate/references/quality-gates-semantics.md and generation/SKILL.md; callerExtras.phaseSkills is derived per ../skills/generation/references/plugins/plugin-detection-guide.md § phaseSkills Derivation. Both are typed only as objects here. NOTE: `research` is OPTIONAL here; generate makes it required for a full generation (and exempt for callerExtras.regenerateOnly re-emits) at runtime — see generate/SKILL.md Step 0.1.

version.description: Schema version. HARD-REQUIRED and the only accepted value. v1 and v2 are rejected.

source.description: Identifier of the calling plugin, e.g. 'onboard:start'.

projectPath.description: Absolute path to the project root.

analysis.description: Phase 1 Recon report — the structured codebase analysis (structure, stack, complexity, configs) that config-generator consumes. Populated by onboard:start's recon; the full field shape is documented in the codebase-analyzer agent. OPTIONAL at the schema level and left permissive (additionalProperties:true, no nested required).

wizardAnswers.description: Phase 3 Grounded Wizard canonical output (projectDescription, teamSize, autonomyLevel, testingPhilosophy, hook/skill/agent tuning, lspPlugins, builtInSkills, painPoints, …). Canonical shape: wizard/SKILL.md § Canonical Output. OPTIONAL at the schema level and left permissive.

modelChoice.description: Resolved default model identifier for generated skill/agent frontmatter, e.g. 'sonnet' | 'opus' | 'haiku' or a pinned model id. Resolved per start SKILL.md § model-resolution. OPTIONAL.

ecosystemPlugins.description: Ecosystem-plugin opt-ins copied from wizardAnswers.ecosystemPlugins, e.g. { notify: boolean }. OPTIONAL; left permissive.

enriched.description: Enriched-tier generation toggles + settings (enableCICD, enableHarness, enableEvolution, enableSprintContracts, enableTeams, enableVerification, willDeploy, ciAuditAction, prReviewTrigger, autoEvolutionMode, verificationStrategy, deployTarget). OPTIONAL; left permissive.

callerExtras.description: Opaque extra context passed through from the caller. Only its presence (as an object) is required; every sub-key below is OPTIONAL and the object is left permissive (additionalProperties:true).

installedPlugins.description: Plugin names the caller detected as installed. Absent → generate probes the filesystem itself (plugin-drift-detection.md § Probe Procedure).

coveredCapabilities.description: Capabilities already covered by installed plugins; agent generation skips these.

pluginSurfaces.description: Entry-surface classification keyed by plugin name — each plugin tagged command-or-skill / hooks-only / agent-only. Consumed by the Plugin Integration template to prevent fabricated slash refs for plugins that expose no slash surface (release-gate finding G.3, 2026-04-17). Built by start's Phase 4 surface probe; generate re-probes when this key is absent. Canonical shape + probe procedure: generation/references/plugins/plugin-surface-probe.md. Typed only as an object here (left permissive).

allowPluginReferences.description: Permit rules/skills to reference installed plugins instead of duplicating guidance. Defaults to true when installedPlugins is non-empty.

allowHttpHooks.description: OFF by default. When false, any qualityGates entry with hookType='http' is refused (skip reason 'http-not-opted-in'). Never auto-inferred.

disableMCP.description: SKIP-PHASE family — when true, skip emission Step 1 (MCP) entirely. Telemetry still records mcpStatus:'skipped'.

disableLSP.description: SKIP-PHASE family — when true, skip emission Step 3 (LSP plugins) entirely. Telemetry still records lspStatus:'skipped'.

disableBuiltInSkills.description: SKIP-PHASE family — when true, skip emission Step 4 (built-in skills) entirely. Telemetry still records builtInSkillsStatus:'skipped'.

disableSkillTuning.description: SUPPRESS-PROMPT family — when true, suppress the per-skill batched confirmation; skill files + snapshot ARE still emitted.

disableAgentTuning.description: SUPPRESS-PROMPT family — when true, suppress the per-agent batched confirmation; agent files + snapshot ARE still emitted.

disableOutputStyleTuning.description: SUPPRESS-PROMPT family — when true, suppress the emission Step 2 output-style confirmation; style file + snapshot ARE still emitted.

lspPlugins.description: Explicit accepted marketplace LSP plugin names for emission Step 3. Empty array = 'detected but declined all'; absent = wizard-driven or full-detected default.

builtInSkills.description: Explicit accepted built-in Claude Code skill names for emission Step 4. Empty array = 'candidates existed but declined all'; absent = wizard-driven or full-candidate default.

regenerateOnly.description: Snapshot re-emit marker AND scope. Canonically an ARRAY of the artifact paths to re-emit — generate honors the scope and writes only the listed files; this is the form every documented caller builds (update/references/drift-application.md § Artifact gap regeneration is the authoritative construction, and the per-component missing-file steps in update/evolve all use it). A bare boolean is also accepted because Step 0.1 tests this key for TRUTHINESS only, never for a path list. When truthy (a non-empty array included), generate's Step 0.1 research contract is exempt (research may be absent) and a present research object is NOT consumed. See generate/SKILL.md Step 0.1.

qualityGates.description: Boundary-enforcement hook spec keyed by event (sessionStart/preCommit/featureStart/postFeature + the nine advanced events). Onboard translates these into .claude/settings.json hook entries. The deep per-event ENTRY shape and the per-entry hookType/aux fields + validation rules are specified in generate/references/quality-gates-semantics.md § qualityGates semantics and generation/references/emission/hooks-generation.md § Hook Type Validation — typed only as an object here (left permissive) to keep validation behavior unchanged.

phaseSkills.description: Per-phase recommended skills (research/planning/feature/review/commit/post-phase) for multi-phase builds, used to compose Plugin Integration narrative + subdir skill annotations. Derivation rules: ../skills/generation/references/plugins/plugin-detection-guide.md § phaseSkills Derivation — typed only as an object here (left permissive).

reResearch.description: v3 re-research marker. Present ONLY on a re-research regen built by onboard:update / onboard:evolve — signals config-generator to run the merge-aware regen path (customization floor + marker surgery + progress-preserving backlog merge). Absent on first onboard and on regenerateOnly snapshot replays. Does NOT change generate Step 0.1 validation.

dimensions.description: the research dimensions refreshed this run (scoped set), or all in-roster dims when escalated

escalatedToFull.description: true when the tiered escalation rule promoted a scoped re-research to full

research.description: Optional synthesized research object. Canonical shape: onboard/schemas/research-dossier.json.
